summary:
Data Scientist with 5 years of experience designing and deploying data-driven
solutions to enhance business decision-making and operational efficiency.
Strong expertise in machine learning, deep learning, generative AI, and advanced
analytics, with hands-on experience building scalable models and end-to-end AI
systems.
Proven ability to transform complex datasets into actionable insights through
predictive modeling, NLP solutions, and AI-powered applications.
Experienced in developing and optimizing data pipelines, feature engineering, and
model evaluation to improve performance and accuracy.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI frameworks to
solve real-world problems and enable intelligent automation.
Skilled in translating business problems into data science solutions, delivering
measurable impact and driving strategic outcomes.
